jobs.title: Project Finance Analyst II
jobs.description:
**What We're Looking For**

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.
  
  
This opportunity entails being responsible for providing financial guidance to project teams, with a focus on budgets, profitability, earnings variances, cash flow, and contract compliance. The Project Analyst acts as the primary financial advisor throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring success in areas such as contracting, compensation and payment terms, workplan/project management system alignment, budgets, cost controls, revenue recognition, and cash and invoice management.  
  
THIS ROLE IS FULLY ONSITE AT LOS ANGELES INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

**What You’ll Do:**

* Engages and supports all financial aspects across the entire project lifecycle.
* Models and analyzes gross margin scenarios from initial engagement through final negotiations, offering revenue and cash performance recommendations and enhancement strategies.
* Ensures the accuracy of the PM system by overseeing changes to budget, commitments, forecasts, and expenditures, aligning work plans with client/contract requirements.
* Reviews and ensures timely and accurate invoice approval and payment applications according to client terms and requirements, including subcontracting needs. Collaborates with the project manager and cash management team to proactively resolve billing and revenue discrepancies.
* Generates and evaluates standard and ad hoc reports to identify and track potential cost issues and overruns. Investigates budget anomalies and resolves variances or escalates concerns to discuss actions.
* Forecasts and monitors project estimate-at-completion (EAC) by recording potential and actual changes to cost accounts, including change orders, trends, and deviations.
* Facilitates an efficient earnings review process with the project team, using GAAP and revenue recognition concepts to analyze project finance performance. Performs project revenue adjustments with general supervision.
* Escalates project performance that impacts office results to the office finance manager in a timely manner.
* Develops client and subconsultant relationships, ensuring effective client service and efficient subconsultant management.
* May offer guidance and mentorship to Project Finance Associates, including oversight of day-to-day work. Utilizes PFAs for routine transactional support.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of financial, project accounting/analysis, or related experience, or
* In lieu of education, 6 years of financial, project accounting/analysis, or related work experience

**What You'll Bring:**

* Ability to manage ownership of the project finance responsibilities for small to medium projects or ownership of a portion of larger projects.
* Ability to read and comprehend contract requirements to ensure adherence.
* Intermediate data analysis skills, able to accurately analyze and interpret data to draw conclusions using tools such as Excel, enterprise reporting systems, and project management systems.
* Intermediate conceptual and analytical skills, driving action on data.
* Intermediate organizational skills, ability to multitask, and self-directed.
* **Ability to work onsite at LAX Airport**

**What We Prefer:**

* Degree in relevant Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, or related field
* Knowledge of project financial management/cost controls
* Knowledge of accounting/financial principles and practices
* Knowledge of A/E industry

jobs.title: Schedule / Cost Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Schedule / Cost Analyst to support a transportation client’s capital program. You’ll own schedule development and updates in Primavera P6, tie schedule progress to cost performance, and turn project data into clear, automated reporting for project managers and agency leadership. **Hands-on scheduling experience is required for this role.**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop, update, and maintain CPM schedules in Primavera P6, including baselines, monthly updates, and progress tracking
* Review contractor schedule submittals for logic, constraints, float, critical path, and compliance with contract specifications
* Perform schedule analysis, including critical path, float consumption, and variance to baseline
* Track budgets, commitments, actuals, forecasts, and estimates at completion
* Integrate schedule and cost data to support earned value reporting (CPI, SPI, EAC)
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that bring schedule and cost data together for project and program leadership
* Automate recurring data pulls, cleanup, and reporting tasks using Python or a similar language
* Prepare monthly schedule narratives and cost reports
* Maintain schedule and cost data in the client’s PMIS (Oracle Primavera Unifier or similar)
* Identify schedule and cost risks early and communicate them clearly to the project team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years of hands-on Primavera P6 experience building and updating schedules
* Demonstrated scheduling experience on construction, transportation, or infrastructure projects
* Working knowledge of CPM scheduling principles, WBS development, and resource/cost loading
* Experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI
* Working knowledge of Python, SQL, R, or a similar language for data analysis and automation
* Experience with project cost tracking, budgets, and forecasting
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data analysis)
* Strong written communication skills for schedule narratives and reports
* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with public agency or transit capital programs
* Familiarity with Oracle Primavera Unifier or another PMIS
* Experience pulling data from P6 or a PMIS through APIs, database queries, or exports for reporting
* Earned value management experience
* PMI-SP, PSP (AACE), or PMP certification a plus

**Schedule & Work Arrangement**

* Part-time, approximately 25-30 hours per week
* Hybrid: 1-2 days on-site at client location in Los Angeles, remainder remote
* Flexible hours within normal business hours

**Why Brio**

* Meaningful work on major public infrastructure programs
* Small, collaborative team with direct access to senior leadership
* Opportunity to grow into a full-time project controls role

*Brio Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

Pay: $56.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Do you have at least 3 year of experience working on Primavera Unifier?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Power BI: 5 years (Required)
* Primavera P6: 2 years (Required)
* Data analysis skills: 3 years (Required)
* Business intelligence: 3 years (Preferred)
* Project scheduling: 2 years (Required)
* Project management: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90012

jobs.title: Buyer II, Avionics
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for an **Avionics Buyer II**, reporting to the **Director, Avionics Supply Chain,** to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of artificial-gravity human-rated space stations.

* Ability to make independent judgments with limited information
* Communication skills for relaying data (verbally and in-writing) between other employees, vendors, and customers

**About Taurus Engineering**

Taurus Engineering Inc. designs and manufactures oilfield equipment. Our Long Beach team builds precision equipment used in demanding field environments, and we depend on a reliable supply chain to keep production on schedule.

**THIS ROLE IS ON-SITE IN LONG, BEACH, CA.**
--------------------------------------------

**$24-$28 DOE**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Purchasing Assistant supports the Purchasing department in buying materials, components, and services for manufacturing operations. You'll process purchase orders, follow up with vendors, track deliveries, and keep records accurate so production has what it needs when it needs it. This role suits someone organized and detail-oriented who wants to grow a career in procurement or supply chain.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare, issue, and maintain purchase orders in the ERP system based on approved requisitions and material requirements
* Request and compare quotes from suppliers for pricing, lead time, and terms
* Follow up with vendors on order confirmations, delivery dates, and backorders, and escalate delays that could affect production
* Coordinate with Receiving, Quality, and Production to resolve discrepancies in quantity, documentation, or specifications
* Match POs, receiving documents, and invoices, and work with Accounting to resolve billing issues
* Track open orders and prepare status reports for the Purchasing Manager
* Help source alternative suppliers for raw materials, machined components, and MRO items
* Support inventory accuracy by monitoring stock levels and flagging reorder needs
* Monitors inventory levels and assists with identifying when materials need to be reordered
* Tracks material availability and communicates potential shortages or delays to the appropriate teams
* Develops and maintains positive working relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Requests and compares vendor quotes and assists with identifying cost-effective purchasing options
* Assists with researching new materials, products, and suppliers when project or production material needs arise
* Optimizes usage based on incoming orders with an emphasis in reducing obsolescence.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* 2–4 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or a related role
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel (sorting, filtering, basic formulas)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication with vendors and internal teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Ability to read basic engineering drawings or material specifications

**Preferred:**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, or a related field
* Experience in a manufacturing environment
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems

Taurus Engineering, Inc. proudly offers a comprehensive benefits package to all regular full-time employees, which includes:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Group Life Insurance & AD&D (Accidental Death and Dismemberment)
* Voluntary Term Life Insurance & AD&D
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Holidays
* 401(k) Retirement Plan (Company Match)

jobs.title: Program Analyst - Fiscal Services Department (Payroll)
jobs.description:
The impact you will have: As a Program Analyst supporting the Fiscal Services Department (Payroll), you will play a key role in ensuring that San José Unified employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with all applicable regulations. You will support payroll operations serving employees across departments and school sites by processing timesheets, coordinating benefit-related payments, and resolving payroll and pay-related inquiries. Your work directly supports employee trust, operational stability, and fiscal accountability. By applying strong analytical, organizational, and customer service skills, you help ensure payroll processes are consistent, compliant, and responsive to the needs of employees, departments, and school sites. A more detailed job description is available at: https://sjusd.box.com/v/program analyst.

**Who you are:** You are a detail-oriented and analytical professional who values accuracy, consistency, and service. You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where deadlines, compliance, and customer service are essential. You take pride in supporting employees and departments through reliable payroll and benefits processes.

**As a Program Analyst on the Payroll team (Fiscal Services Department), you will be responsible for (but not limited to):**

* Processing and reviewing employee timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
* Supporting payroll processing for certificated, classified, and hourly employees
* Processing and reconciling benefit-related payments and payroll deductions
* Providing customer service and technical support to employees, departments, and school sites regarding payroll and pay-related matters
* Researching and resolving payroll discrepancies, adjustments, and inquiries in a timely manner
* Collaborating with Human Resources, Finance, and school sites to ensure accurate employee pay and benefits information
* Ensuring compliance with district policies, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable local, state, and federal regulations
* Maintaining payroll records and documentation in accordance with audit and retention requirements
* Assisting with payroll reporting, data analysis, and reconciliation activities
* Supporting process improvement efforts to increase efficiency, accuracy, and consistency in payroll operations
* Contributing to a culture of service, accountability, and professionalism within the Payroll and Business Services teams

**What you need for this position:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred)
* Two (2) or more years of experience in payroll, accounting, or financial operations
* Experience processing payroll and/or supporting payroll functions in a large or complex organization
* Strong understanding of payroll processes, including timesheets, deductions, and compliance requirements
* Proficiency in using payroll systems, financial systems, or ERP systems
* Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Excel for data tracking, analysis, and reporting

**SB 848 Child Safety & Employment Disclosure Requirement**

Effective January 1, 2026, in accordance with California Senate Bill 848 (School Employee Misconduct/Child Abuse Prevention Act), applicants for employment with San José Unified are subject to enhanced child safety, training, and employment disclosure requirements.

Under SB 848, schools are required to strengthen background vetting procedures and obtain employment history information related to allegations of egregious misconduct involving students. Former employers may be contacted to release records regarding substantiated findings of misconduct as permitted by law. Failure to provide complete and accurate information regarding prior educational employment or relevant misconduct findings may result in disqualification from the hiring process or withdrawal of an offer of employment.

SB 848 also expands mandated reporter requirements and requires annual child abuse prevention training for employees and certain volunteers by July 1, 2026. All employees must comply with district-adopted child safety policies, including procedures for supervising and protecting students.

San José Unified is committed to maintaining a safe and supportive learning environment for all students and will review all disclosures and employment records in accordance with state law.

When will you hear back from us: Within seven days of applying, we will inform you if you will be moving forward in our hiring process and share next steps. If there is a delayed response, feel free to reach out to us at classified@sjusd.org.

**Note to internal applicants:**

* Even though we may have some information on file for you, we encourage you to submit a letter of introduction highlighting your qualifications and interest in this role, as well as any other information you would like to share. Where applicable, please also note which available location you are applying to.
* To be eligible to interview, you will need to be in good evaluation standing.

This role is ideal for someone who comes directly from a **CNC machine shop or precision machining environment** and understands what it takes to keep manufacturing operations running efficiently. You'll be responsible for purchasing raw materials, cutting tools, manufacturing supplies, and outside processing services while working closely with production, engineering, and quality teams.

We're looking for someone who understands the realities of a machine shop—tight production schedules, material lead times, tooling requirements, changing priorities, and the importance of having the right materials available when they're needed.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership purchasing position where you'll have a direct impact on production efficiency, supplier performance, and the company's continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage purchasing activities for raw materials, metals, CNC cutting tools, tooling components, manufacturing supplies, and outside processing services.
* Work directly with CNC machinists, programmers, manufacturing engineers, and production teams to understand material and tooling requirements.
* Source and negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive pricing, reliable lead times, and consistent material availability.
* Manage supplier relationships, evaluate quotations, and identify opportunities to improve cost and delivery performance.
* Track open purchase orders, expedite critical materials, and proactively resolve supply chain issues that could delay production.
* Coordinate purchasing requirements with production schedules and changing manufacturing priorities.
* Purchase materials and services according to technical specifications, engineering drawings, and quality requirements.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, pricing, and delivery schedules within ERP/MRP systems.
* Support aerospace and defense quality requirements, including material certifications, traceability, and approved supplier processes.

  
**Requirements**  

* **5+ years of purchasing, procurement, or buying experience within a CNC machine shop or precision machining environment.**
* **Must have direct experience purchasing materials, tooling, or manufacturing services for a machine shop.**
* Strong understanding of CNC machining operations, manufacturing workflows, and the materials and tooling used in precision manufacturing.
* Experience sourcing metals, raw materials, cutting tools, industrial supplies, and/or outside machining and processing services.
* Proven ability to negotiate pricing, manage supplier relationships, and coordinate material deliveries around production schedules.
* Comfortable working directly with machinists, manufacturing engineers, production managers, and quality personnel.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems to manage purchase orders, supplier information, and material requirements.
* Ability to interpret technical specifications, purchasing requirements, and manufacturing documentation.

  
**Benefits**  

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Paid Time Off (PTO)

jobs.description:
**About the team:**
-------------------

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

**About the role:**
-------------------

Rubrik is seeking a Senior Commercial Compliance Analyst to lead Commercial Audit and Certification Management. In this role, you will own Rubrik's portfolio of security certifications and coordinated audits end-to-end, from evidence collection through auditor management to final report delivery, ensuring audit readiness is continuous and audit findings are tracked to closure.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Own the audit and certification calendar across Rubrik's active portfolio: SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, CSA STAR Level 1 and Level 2, TISAX Level 1 and Level 2, HITRUST, HIPAA.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, managing scoping, fieldwork, evidence requests, and remediation of findings through to closure.
* Maintain the mapping between compliance controls and underlying evidence sources so audit readiness is continuous rather than a point-in-time scramble.
* Drive coordinated audit strategy, consolidating overlapping evidence requests across frameworks to reduce duplicate work for control owners.
* Lead evaluation and scoping of emerging and planned certifications to support Rubrik's international and AI governance expansion.
* Manage the lifecycle of certifications end-to-end, including retirements and transitions
* Track and report audit status, findings, and remediation progress to leadership, using the team's Jira-based tracking dashboards.
* Partner with control owners across InfoSec, IT, Legal, and Engineering to gather evidence and close audit findings on schedule.
* Collaborate with Risk Management to ensure audit findings feed into the broader risk register and remediation lifecycle (RMLC).
* Support Customer Trust Enablement by ensuring audit and certification outputs are readily usable to answer customer security inquiries.
* Leverage AI and automation to streamline evidence gathering, control testing, and audit workflows.

**Experience you'll need:**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in security compliance, audit management, or GRC
* Hands-on experience managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 audits, plus at least one additional framework
* Experience working directly with external auditors and certification bodies, including scoping and negotiating audit timelines.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent audit cycles.
* Familiarity with GRC tooling and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) for tracking evidence and remediation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

In this role, you will support the company’s financial reporting and accounting operations by preparing SEC filings, completing key accounting processes, and maintaining accurate financial documentation. You will contribute to both reporting and operational accounting activities, ensuring high-quality outputs that support compliance, audits, and strategic decision-making. This position offers the opportunity to work collaboratively across departments while growing your accounting expertise in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Assists with preparing and filing quarterly and annual Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Forms 10‑Q and 10‑K, including financial statements, Notes, and Management Discussion & Analysis (MD'&A).
* Prepares supporting documentation, schedules, and tie‑outs for financial statement disclosures.
* Monitors new accounting standards and SEC guidance and assists with implementing related accounting and disclosure changes.
* Coordinates information collection across Legal, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP'&A), Investor Relations, and other teams.
* Completes technical accounting research and prepares memoranda.
* Prepares journal entries and account reconciliations for assigned areas, including equity and stock‑based compensation.
* Prepares schedules and supports accounting and reporting for stock‑based compensation.
* Prepares the consolidated statement of cash flows for each reporting period.
* Supports month‑end and quarter‑end close activities and internal controls, including Sarbanes‑Oxley (SOX) compliance.
* Supports external audit requests and assists with accounting process improvements and system enhancements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license.
* Public accounting experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in financial reporting, technical accounting, and/or accounting operations.
* Solid knowledge of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and financial statement preparation, including areas such as Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 606, ASC 805, ASC 718, ASC 842, and ASC 470.
* Ability to manage and coordinate deliverables across multiple teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* None provided.

**Special Mentions**

* Minimal travel may be required for this position.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD'&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Toolio, particularly in merchandise financial planning, system implementation, business process configuration, and planning transformation initiatives.

This role will support merchandise planning across multiple categories or business divisions, driving sales, gross margin, inventory investment, open-to-buy strategies, and forecasting accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

Merchandise Financial Planning and Strategy

* Lead long-range, annual, seasonal, and in-season merchandise financial planning.

* Translate business strategies into actionable financial plans and performance targets.
* Establish merchandise planning methodologies, calendars, processes, and governance standards.

Toolio Implementation and Planning Systems

* Collaborate with business stakeholders and implementation teams to define planning requirements and workflows.

Forecasting and Business Performance

* Lead weekly and monthly merchandise financial reforecasting.
* Develop scenario models, financial risk assessments, and forecasting recommendations.
* Analyze sales performance, gross margin, inventory levels, and merchandise productivity.
* Recommend chase, cut, and promotional actions based on business performance.
* Present financial planning results and recommendations to senior leadership.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Advisory

* Partner with merchandising, finance, planning, supply chain, and technology teams.
* Provide guidance on merchandise planning best practices.
* Prepare executive business reviews, financial plans, and performance presentations.
* Support category strategy, assortment investment, pricing, and inventory decisions.

Required Qualifications

* Extensive professional experience in retail merchandise financial planning.
* Strong expertise in merchandise planning across multiple categories or business divisions.

* Strong understanding of:

  + Merchandise Financial Planning (MFP)
  + Open-to-Buy (OTB)
  + Sales and Gross Margin Planning
  + Inventory Turnover and Receipts Planning
  + Seasonal and Annual Planning
  + In-Season Forecasting
  + Scenario Modeling
  + Merchandise Performance Analytics
* Experience defining merchandise planning processes and business requirements.
* Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to advise senior stakeholders and translate financial insights into business recommendations.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Direct experience implementing or optimizing Toolio merchandise planning applications.
* Experience with Invent.ai, Anaplan, Oracle RPAS/RDF, Blue Yonder, or o9.
* Experience supporting retail planning system transformation initiatives.
* Experience with AI-driven demand forecasting and inventory optimization.
* Experience in apparel, fashion, lifestyle, or specialty retail environments.

jobs.title: Schedule/Cost Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Schedule / Cost Analyst to support a transportation client’s capital program. Hands-on scheduling experience is required for this role.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Develop, update, and maintain CPM schedules in Primavera P6, including baselines, monthly updates, and progress tracking  
Review contractor schedule submittals for logic, constraints, float, critical path, and compliance with contract specifications  
Perform schedule analysis, including critical path, float consumption, and variance to baseline  
Track budgets, commitments, actuals, forecasts, and estimates at completion  
Integrate schedule and cost data to support earned value reporting (CPI, SPI, EAC)  
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that bring schedule and cost data together for project and program leadership  
Automate recurring data pulls, cleanup, and reporting tasks using Python or a similar language  
Prepare monthly schedule narratives and cost reports  
Maintain schedule and cost data in the client’s PMIS (Oracle Primavera Unifier or similar)  
Identify schedule and cost risks early and communicate them clearly to the project team.

**Required Qualifications**

Minimum 2 years of hands-on Primavera P6 experience building and updating schedules  
Demonstrated scheduling experience on construction, transportation, or infrastructure projects  
Working knowledge of CPM scheduling principles, WBS development, and resource/cost loading  
Experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI  
Working knowledge of Python, SQL, R, or a similar language for data analysis and automation  
Experience with project cost tracking, budgets, and forecasting  
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data analysis)  
Strong written communication skills for schedule narratives and reports  
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with public agency or transit capital programs  
Familiarity with Oracle Primavera Unifier or another PMIS  
Experience pulling data from P6 or a PMIS through APIs, database queries, or exports for reporting  
Earned value management experience  
PMI-SP, PSP (AACE), or PMP certification a plus  
Schedule & Work Arrangement

Part-time, approximately 25-30 hours per week  
Hybrid: 1-2 days on-site at client location in Los Angeles, remainder remote  
Flexible hours within normal business hours

**Education:**

Bachelor's (Required)  
Experience:

Power BI: 5 years (Required)  
Primavera P6: 2 years (Required)  
Data analysis skills: 3 years (Required)  
Business intelligence: 3 years (Preferred)  
Project scheduling: 2 years (Required)  
Project management: 2 years (Preferred)

Pay: $56.00 per hour

Expected hours: 25.0 – 30.0 per week

* Do you have at least 3 year of experience working on Primavera Unifier?
* Do you have at least 2 years of hands-on experience developing, building, updating, and maintaining CPM schedules in Primavera P6?
* Do you have hands-on project scheduling experience on construction, transportation, transit, or infrastructure projects?
* Do you have at least 5 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports?

jobs.title: Buyer/Planner
jobs.description:
Honda Racing Corporation, USA, a leader in motorsports racing, is seeking a highly organized Buyer/Planner for its Santa Clarita, California (North Los Angeles County) location.

Responsibilities:

The purpose of this position is to plan production requirements, provide forecasts to key suppliers, source parts and services, and purchase parts and materials (both internally, within HRC shops, and externally via outside suppliers) to support production, development, and race component requirements. This position is a key role that manages the supply chain core functions from planning analysis, part review, supplier bids/negotiations, delivery, and quality assurance support that results in best value to meet critical assembly, development testing, and race team activities.

Planning Analysis/Purchasing - Lead production planning analysis and ensure timely release of purchase orders to meet assembly build requirements, based on the certified Bill of Materials (BOM). Provide annual forecasts to long lead and major engine suppliers. Negotiate best price, economic ordering quantities (EOQ), and desired delivery, based on production needs and project milestones. Ensure Purchase Orders are maintained with current information for expected receipt dates and any supplier delay notes. jobs.title: Human Data - Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Human Data powers model training and evaluation by producing high-quality human-generated data at scale. This role focuses on the metrics, systems, and operating insights that help Human Data run efficiently—spanning workforce performance, capacity and allocation, operational process health, and decision-making support for cross-functional partners. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with strong quantitative skills and operational judgment, able to turn incomplete data into clear recommendations that improve throughput, quality, cost, and reliability. You will partner with operations leaders, engineering stakeholders, and enabling teams to identify problems, build operating systems, and drive improved planning decisions.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Perform analyses of Human Data operational metrics—such as capacity, utilization, quality, throughput, cycle time, cost efficiency, and workforce health—to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain reporting, trackers, and dashboards that make core operating KPIs visible and actionable for managers and cross-functional partners.
* Develop and improve planning and forecasting views (e.g., demand signals, supply/capacity, staffing needs, or process volumes) that support proactive, informed decisions.
* Support allocation and operating tradeoffs by synthesizing operational and performance data into clear recommendations for who/what should move where.
* Design, document, and refine operational processes and escalation paths so recurring work - performance actions, staffing, handoffs, and similar flows - is consistent, measurable, and scalable.
* Identify data gaps and partner with stakeholders to improve data collection, hygiene, and definitions so analysis and operating systems remain reliable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, engineering, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and other partners to integrate insights into hiring, staffing, performance management, and operational planning decisions.
* Deliver concise readouts and recommendations to stakeholders, translating analysis into business-oriented next steps and tradeoffs.
* Own ad-hoc research and special projects that improve Human Data operating leverage.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, business operations, consulting, workforce/operations analysis, or growth/ops strategy
* 1+ years of experience building and owning analytical models, trackers, or operating systems in Excel / Google Sheets or equivalent

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
* Experience with forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or performance metrics
* Proficiency in statistical or analytical techniques (e.g., cohort analysis, regression, time-series, anomaly detection) in Python, R, or similar
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or modern BI workflows
* Background in high-growth tech, marketplace/staffing operations, data labeling, human-in-the-loop systems, or consulting environments
* Excellent communication skills, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
* Project management experience, including prioritizing work in fast-paced settings and driving process change with diverse stakeholders
* Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis and operational workflow design

### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Weekend work may be required.
* Travel to other SpaceXSI sites may be required.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$122,000 - $180,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

* Maintain supplier pricing, lead times, and purchasing parameters within NetSuite.
* Plan and manage inventory to support reagent manufacturing schedules and customer demand.
* Utilize NetSuite MRP to generate and execute purchasing and replenishment plans.
* Monitor supplier deliveries, open orders, and lead times to ensure on-time material availability.
* Receive, inspect, and process incoming materials, chemicals, reagents, and laboratory supplies, and verify shipments against purchase orders, packing slips, and Certificates of Analysis (CoA).
* Coordinate incoming inspection and release activities with Quality and Manufacturing teams.
* Manage temperature-sensitive shipments including ambient, refrigerated, frozen, and dry-ice materials.
* Maintain accurate item master records and inventory data within NetSuite, including units of measure, lead times, storage conditions, and supplier information.

* Generate inventory, purchasing, and supplier performance reports to support business decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Analyst

**Location** – **Remote**  
This role is eligible to be performed remotely, however, if you reside within 100 miles of Organic Valley offices in WI, you will be expected to collaborate onsite in a hybrid fashion for 4-8 times per month. If you reside outside of 100 miles, you will travel in 4 times/year for intentional collaboration and connection.
  
**Employee Type** – Salaried  
**Bonus** – This position is eligible for a 3% annual incentive bonus based on cooperative and individual performance.  
**Safety Sensitive** – No  
  
**Summary of Role**  
The Senior Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting financial planning and analysis activities, including forecasting, budgeting, financial modeling, and business performance analysis. This role provides financial insights and recommendations that support decision-making and help drive business performance across the Cooperative. The Senior Financial Analyst partners cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Accounting, and other business leaders to develop forecasts, analyze results, identify risks and opportunities, and improve financial reporting. The role leverages financial systems, reporting tools, and data analytics to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable business insights. The Senior Financial Analyst serves as a trusted business partner by translating complex financial information into meaningful recommendations, influencing business decisions, and supporting operational and strategic objectives.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  
FP&A Analysis and Forecasting – 35% of time  

* Support budget, forecast, and business performance analysis.
* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reporting models.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, and trend analysis to support decision-making.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, complete, and timely.
* Partner with business areas to develop forecasts, budgets, and performance analysis.
* Build and maintain financial models to support planning and strategy.
* Analyze KPIs, trends, and market conditions to identify opportunities and risks.
* Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve business performance.
* Translate financial results, trends, and risks into actionable business insights.

Business Partnership and Decision Support – 35% of time  

* Partner with leadership to drive results and meet targets.
* Participate on cross-functional teams and support assigned categories.
* Respond to business inquiries and provide financial insights and recommendations.
* Influence business decisions through financial analysis and fact-based recommendations.
* Communicate complex financial information clearly and effectively to business leaders.

Reporting and Strategic Analysis – 20% of time  

* Prepare ad hoc reporting and analysis for Executive Team and Business Leadership.
* Identify trends and recommend actions to improve business performance.
* Present financial results and insights through clear reporting and analysis.
* Develop executive-level presentations that communicate key financial drivers, risks, and opportunities.

Financial Systems Support – 10% of time  

* Maintain the financial planning system through data uploads, revisions, and reporting.
* Monitor reporting outputs and identify causes of variances.
* Support continuous improvement of reporting tools and processes.
* Develop and enhance automated reporting, dashboard, and analytical solutions.
* Utilize Power BI and other reporting tools to improve financial insights and reporting efficiency.
* Support data governance, reporting standardization, and financial system optimization initiatives.
* Drive automation and process improvements to reduce manual reporting and improve data accuracy.

  
**Additional Duties and Responsibilities**  

* Participate in cross-functional initiatives, process improvement efforts, and special projects as assigned.
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

  
**Knowledge, Skills and Competencies**  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
* Five or more years of finance, accounting, analytical, or related business experience required
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial statements, and US GAAP.
* Advanced analytical, financial modeling, forecasting, and quantitative analysis skills including variance analysis
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and financial modeling tools.
* Advanced data visualization, reporting, and presentation tools; Power BI experience preferred.
* Strong PowerPoint, presentation, and financial storytelling capabilities.
* Ability to analyze complex financial and operational data and translate results into actionable business insights including strategic narratives for executive leadership
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to build effective relationships and partner with business leaders across functions.
* Ability to influence decisions through financial analysis, recommendations, and fact-based insights.
* Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail by ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial data, reporting, forecasts, and business analyses.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Ability to develop subject matter expertise within assigned business areas.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and process optimization.
* Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and effectively to audiences at all organizational levels.
* Ability to remain current on emerging trends, technologies, and accounting or financial reporting developments.

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Analyst III
jobs.description:
At **Benchmark**, we are driven by our purpose: to innovate for a healthier, safer, and better-connected world to create a brighter future. When you join us, you become part of a team passionate about making a meaningful impact across various sectors, including commercial aerospace, defense, advanced computing, next-generation communications, complex industrials, medical, and semiconductor capital equipment. We prioritize career growth, fostering a culture that ensures you reach your full potential. At Benchmark, your work is purpose-driven, enabling you to create a positive impact on the world and make your career truly meaningful. You’ll be part of a collaborative and inclusive team that values your ideas and contributions.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Trade Compliance Analyst III supports import and export activities and procedures that ensure compliance with local and international laws and regulatory regimes as applicable to the movement of goods internationally.

**PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

**EXPORT ACTIVITIES**

* Maintain knowledge of compliance to the EAR, the FTR and ITAR.
* Assist in review and/or writing export procedures.
* Work with Corporate Trade Compliance Management on any potential export compliance matters.
* Manage the Customer Document Vetting portal
* Manage the End User Certification process with all U.S. Benchmark customers
* Manage the export licensing log process
* Knowledge of export license exceptions and how to apply them on restricted exports
* Maintain the export license exception log when applicable.
* Prepare complex U.S. Department of Commerce licenses and/or export authorizations.
* Assist Corporate Trade Compliance Managers on managing of Annual Sales Reports for Dept of State agreements
* Conduct export classification (ECCN/USML) of documentation and/or products.
* Share updated, current parts database with brokers.
* Perform denied parties checks on business partners.
* Manage and coordinate daily export activity.
* Review and/or maintain site export documentation.
* Participate in Corporate quarterly export audits.
* Participate in Corporate annual Risk Assessments for Export Program.
* Participate in site export disclosures with Corporate Trade Compliance team.
* Assist Corporate Trade Compliance Manager on ruling requests and/or CCATs.
* Other compliance related duties as assigned.
* Assist with international transitions.
* Write and provide training to employees on export matters.
* Maintain and update classification information (ECCN, USML and licensing) in local part database and/or ERP system.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

**Education / Experience**

* Customs Broker license or Export Compliance Certification which has renewal requirements involving additional training annually or bi-annually
* Bachelor’s degree and/or 7 or more years of export experience preferred

**Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effective interpersonal skills
* Effective multitasking skills and the ability to take on additional responsibilities as required
* Effective organization and prioritization skills
* Demonstrate high attention to detail
* Ability to work with diverse groups
* Demonstrates discretion, confidentiality, independent judgment and professionalism.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and guidance, exercising discretion and independent judgment.
* Understanding of and ability to use continuous improvement tools.
* Strong customer service and client focus
* Working knowledge of productivity tools, including Microsoft Office products and WebEx conferencing software
* Ability to support a 24/7 global business operation as required
* Effective negotiation and problem solving skills
* Ability to work in an ever-changing, dynamic, fast-paced environment
* Knowledge/Familiarity with “maquiladora/IMEX” operations a plus
* Knowledge/Familiarity working in an ERP system a plus

**Abilities**

* Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 5 pounds 5% or less of the workday
* Must be able stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl 5% or less of the workday
* Must be able to talk, see, hear, concentrate, think, and reason
* Must be able to sit for prolonged periods of time throughout the workday.
* Must be able to use a keyboard and do manual tasks for prolonged periods of time throughout the workday.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

**Geographical Location: Remote**

**Physical Location: Remote - Arizona**

**Shift: Shift 1**

**Work Schedule: M-F 0800-1700**

**Full Time**

In our innovative environment, you'll work with cutting-edge technology, leading the way in engineering design and delivering world-class manufacturing services for products that make a real difference in the lives of others. At Benchmark, your career is more than just a job. It’s an opportunity to be part of something bigger, where your work matters and helps shape a brighter future for everyone. **Together, we will achieve extraordinary things.**

**Export Control:** This job position may include access to controlled information or technology covered under applicable U.S. export control laws. As such, employment for this job position may be contingent on either verification that an applicant falls under the definition of a “U.S. Person” (which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. lawful permanent residents, and those granted U.S. asylum or refugee status) or on the Company timely obtaining any necessary export license required under federal laws. The Company evaluates such export license situations on a case-by-case basis and may decline to proceed with a job applicant in its sole discretion since export license applications can take many weeks to be processed.

Benchmark is an equal opportunity employer. We are bringing together a dynamic workforce with unique talents, life experiences, cultures, and perspectives to promote an innovative, collaborative, and creative place to work. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at careers@b

You’ll also partner with internal operations functions, working together to support the programs and improve efficiency. The FP&A Manager will also manage two Financial Analysts and help grow the FP&A function. This role calls for a proactive, detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, carries multiple priorities at once, and can make complicated financial ideas clear to stakeholders at every level.
  
This exempt, full-time position reports to the Associate Director, FP&A. This position is remote-eligible and open to applicants nationwide; however, preference will be given to candidates based in Seattle or New York who can work in a hybrid capacity.

  

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**  
*Program Financial Management & Advisory*

* Manage a portfolio of program budgets in close collaboration with program staff
* Report monthly on budget vs. actuals and forecast, analyzing variances, trends, and performance metrics to give program leaders and management clear, actionable insights
* Partner with program staff and business stakeholders to build annual budgets, forecasts, and long-term plans across a diverse portfolio of projects, and roll results up into Panorama's organization-wide budget process
* Manage grant financials across the full lifecycle — partnering with program staff on budget proposals for prospective grants and partnerships, developing grant budgets, and preparing financial deliverables for grant reports
* Partner with the broader finance team, using Sage Intacct to keep program financials accurate, timely, and consistent across the portfolio

*Financial Strategy & Operations*

* Build and maintain financial models and tools that support strategic planning, program decisions, and operational analysis
* Support organizational forecasting and month-end close as part of the broader finance team
* Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for internal and external stakeholders, highlighting KPIs, trends, and variances
* Develop reports and dashboards that support internal operations, advancing our use of Sage across the team

*Team Leadership and Cross-functional Collaboration*

* Provide operational and team leadership for the FP&A team, including two direct reports
* Serve as a reviewer for FP&A team members' work, helping strengthen their models, processes, and financial judgment
* Identify and implement process improvements within the FP&A function, documenting new processes as they take hold
* Partner with cross-functional teams to operationalize system enhancements and improve how finance works with the rest of the organization
  

**Desired Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree and at least 6 years of relevant professional experience, including 2 years of people management experience.
* Exceptional critical thinking and analytical skills including a solid understanding of financial and accounting concepts
* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with the ability to absorb and synthesize data and distill key insights
* Strong judgment and a demonstrated understanding of how to handle sensitive and confidential information
* Ability to communicate sophisticated data and financial concepts to partners with a diverse set of backgrounds, including internal and external stakeholders
* Experience managing budgets in partnership with non-finance stakeholders
* Grant budgeting and reporting experience (nonprofit/fiscal sponsorship preferred)
* Experience working at a nonprofit, NGO, or start-up
* Experience using AI in your day-to-day work
* Experience with financial management software — Sage and Salesforce in particular

**Compensation & Benefits**

When determining an initial offer, we carefully consider these factors: candidate skill and experience; room for growth within the band; and internal equity across the team.

Curtin Maritime is a founder-owned, private equity-backed company with entrepreneurial roots and a rapidly growing presence in marine transportation, offshore vessel operations, and marine construction. Our customers include some of the world’s largest maritime, aerospace, and defense companies, and our Long Beach operations are at the center of it all.

,

A successful candidate will be a key part of the Workforce Planning and Analysis team within the Universal Studios Hollywood Finance organization. Specifically, the role will play a lead role in the Labor Forecasting (roster/hiring planning) process and bring data analysis and reporting capability broadly to operations management and to the Labor Support team. Labor Forecasting

* Owner of hiring plans for USH. Partners with Industrial Engineering, Theme Park departments, HR Staffing and Learning & Organizational Development teams to understand and model business labor needs, budget, and corresponding hiring targets for all departments and for all seasons

Analytics and Reporting

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**INSIDER THREAT PROGRAM ANALYST**

SpaceX is seeking a dynamic and driven individual with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Our goal is to protect some of the world's most advanced technologies including rockets, Dragon capsules for human transport, inter-planetary transport vehicles, the world's largest satellite communications network, etc. As an industry leader, we are a target of adversaries, both foreign and domestic, focused on slowing us down and accessing our proprietary technology. The work we do will literally safeguard mankind becoming an interplanetary species.

You will be responsible for the research, analysis, production, and dissemination of information relevant to protecting the safety and security of personnel, brand, global assets, intellectual property, and operations at SpaceX. This role will triage anomalous event data and analyze insider threat program datasets to respond to threats posed to SpaceX. You will use comprehensive understanding of various collection methods and platforms to explore new data sources, build effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Conduct comprehensive investigations and analysis in support of SpaceX intellectual property and security
* Uphold investigation and analytic tradecraft standards including confidentiality, objectivity, lawfulness, timeliness, and use of all available sources of information
* Collect and analyze available program data to evaluate insider threat risk to SpaceX infrastructure, programs, and operations
* Triage anomalous event data associated with indicators of data exfiltration, data destruction and other key indicators of concern
* Conduct internal investigations working with Information Security, HR, Legal, Government Security, Physical Security, and external partners based on information derived from internal and external sources
* Utilize network monitoring, data analytic, and other tools (DLP/SIEM/UEBA) to identify anomalous activity, initiate investigations and decipher underlying trends
* Extract and organize insider threat program data to build metrics, reports and case studies addressing mission requirements and timelines
* Communicate findings in a timely and accurate manner to team members, management, and relevant stakeholders
* Support employee training and briefings for internal and external audiences
* Liaise with external industry and government partners to benchmark insider threat program, share threat intelligence, and further investigations
* Continuously identify and help implement program improvement methods
* Manage and safeguard sensitive information, including case files, employee PII, and intelligence reports

* Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of professional experience in internal investigations, information security, or counterintelligence; OR 4+ years professional experience in information security, internal investigations, or counterintelligence in lieu of a degree

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 1+ year using a SIEM and/or conducting digital forensic investigations in a government or corporate environment
* Working level understanding of insider threat program missions, internal stakeholders, and manifestations of insider threats
* Proficiency in Microsoft Purview for eDiscovery

* Experience conducting preliminary assessments, determining scope, investigation planning, evidence collection/handling, interviewing and reporting findings to internal and external stakeholders

* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and concise reports
* Highly organized with a strong attention to detail
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
* Can swiftly adapt to new technical environments and workflows
* Ability to exercise discretion when conducting confidential investigations

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support critical efforts and operations
* Must be willing to travel ad hoc
* Active TS/SCI clearance, or ability to obtain one. With an active clearance, candidates will be subject to pre-employment screening including background check and drug/alcohol test as well as random drug and alcohol testing during employment

Level 1: $85,000 - $110,000

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. jobs.description:
* Location: On-site at Field Fresh Foods

About Us
  
At Field Fresh Foods, we are passionate about delivering the freshest, highest-quality produce to our customers. As a trusted industry leader, we specialize in providing customized fresh food solutions to restaurants, retailers, and food service providers. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability drives everything we do.
  
We believe in fostering a collaborative, dynamic, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are empowered to take ownership of their roles and make a real impact. At Field Fresh Foods, you won’t just have a job, you’ll build a fulfilling career with opportunities for advancement, professional development, and a supportive team that values your contributions. If you’re looking to join a company that values hard work, fresh ideas, and efficiency, we’d love to have you on board.
  
Job Summary
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized MRO Buyer/Purchaser to manage inventory, order supplies, and support the maintenance team by ensuring the availability of essential parts and tools. This role is responsible for tracking inventory levels, negotiating with vendors, and keeping accurate records of maintenance supplies. The ideal candidate has experience with inventory management, purchasing, and strong negotiation skills to optimize costs while maintaining quality and efficiency.
  
Bilingual in Spanish and English is preferred to effectively communicate with maintenance staff and vendors.
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Maintain inventory of maintenance parts, tools, and supplies, ensuring stock levels are accurate
* Order and receive parts, tools, and equipment as needed to support maintenance operations
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, and terms with vendors and suppliers to optimize costs and ensure timely deliveries
* Track and record inventory usage, deliveries, and reorders using inventory management systems
* Issue parts and tools to maintenance technicians, ensuring proper documentation
* Conduct regular cycle counts and inventory audits to prevent shortages or overstocking
* Assist in organizing and labeling storage areas to improve efficiency and accessibility
* Work closely with the maintenance team to anticipate needs and minimize downtime
* Maintain detailed records of purchases, work orders, and maintenance logs
* Communicate effectively in both English and Spanish to support maintenance staff

What You Bring to the Table
  
**✅ Education:** High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s degree or technical certification preferred
  
**✅ Experience:** 1-2 years of experience in inventory management, purchasing, or maintenance support
  
**✅ Bilingual:** Fluent in Spanish and English (Preferred)
  
**✅ Negotiation Skills:** Ability to negotiate pricing, contracts, and terms with vendors to maximize cost savings
  
**✅ Organizational Skills:** Ability to track, manage, and maintain inventory records with accuracy
  
**✅ Technical Skills:** Experience using inventory management software, spreadsheets, and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
  
**✅ Problem-Solving Mindset:** Ability to anticipate maintenance team needs and resolve supply chain issues
  
**✅ Attention to Detail:** Ensuring accurate record-keeping and compliance with company policies
  
**✅ Physical Requirements:** Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and move parts and equipment as needed
  
Why Join Field Fresh Foods?
  
We know that great employees are the foundation of our success, and we’re committed to providing a rewarding and supportive work environment. Here’s what we offer:
  

* Competitive pay with performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
* 401(k) to help you plan for the future
* Employee discounts on fresh products
* On-Demand Pay to access your earnings when you need them
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional development

**Why Vagaro?**At Vagaro, we believe in fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where every team member can thrive. Our culture is built on innovation, continuous learning, and a passion for making a positive impact. We support our employees' growth and vision for themselves, offering opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Join us and be part of a team that values creativity, teamwork, and a commitment to excellence. Plus, we know how to have fun while getting the job done!

**What you'll be doing:** This role offers close exposure to the people who run the business and real ownership of the work. Vagaro is a vertical SaaS and payments platform serving more than 100,000 business owners across beauty, wellness, and fitness. Our finance team is small, so every analyst takes on real responsibility early.

You will work directly with the Head of FP&A and present to our senior leadership (CEO, CFO, COO, etc.). The questions you take on are the ones leadership acts on:

* Which customer segments and acquisition channels earn their cost, and where should we put the next dollar?
* What do our pricing, product, and GTM bets do for growth and margin?

You will be involved in the full arc of the work: building the model, forming a view, making a recommendation, and supporting the operating team after the decision has been made.

**\****This role is based onsite in Pleasanton, CA Monday through Friday\**

**Compensation**

* **Base Annual Salary: $110,000 - $140,000**

* Own analyses that inform major decisions: pricing, product investment, go-to-market, and capital allocation.
* Build and maintain the company's core operating model, including EBITDA forecasting, churn analysis, and unit economics, and use it to run scenarios and sensitivities.
* Turn ambiguous questions into structured analyses, then into clear recommendations for senior leadership, usually as a short memo or a few slides.
* Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Operations leaders to size opportunities and track whether the bets pay off.

**Planning and Forecasting**

**You may recognize yourself here...**

* You have a record of strong performance, such as early promotions, challenging assignments, or added responsibility.
* You think in structure: you can break an ambiguous question into pieces and work toward a clear answer.

**Classification:** Regular, Full Time, Exempt

**About Us: Caminar** is a leading behavioral health organization that supported over 48,000 youth and adults across six counties in Northern California and the San Francisco Bay Area last year.
  
  
**Caminar's mission** is to build strength and stability through comprehensive mental health and substance use treatment and wrap-around services delivered through evidence-based, whole-person care. **Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Performance Metrics: Prepare monthly financial packages and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the financial performance and health of the organization.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams across finance and including operations, marketing, and sales, to provide financial insights and support decision-making.
* Grants and Program: Support grant budget development and monitoring. Analyze program financial performance and funding utilization, partner with Controller, Accounting team, and operational leaders on financial stewardship.
* Systems and Process Improvement: Improve reporting automation and financial processes, enhance data quality and business intelligence capabilities, support ERP and reporting system optimization.
* Analyze actual-to-budget results and provide actionable recommendations in partnership with Controller, accounting team, operational leaders.

* Technology: Experience with MS Business Intelligence solutions including the ability to create simple reports.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analysis
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst

**The Position:** The Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst is a full-time position reporting to the Manager of Decision Support. The role prepares organizational budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and long-range financial planning, with particular attention participant care costs, and utilization. Working with department leaders and executive management, the Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst translates financial and operational data into actionable recommendations that support organizational sustainability, growth, and informed strategic growth.

Success in this role is measured by budget and forecast accuracy, timely and actionable variance reporting, effective financial partnership with leaders, and measurable improvements in planning and reporting processes.

The annual pay range for the Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst position at Center for Elders’ Independence is $104,332 to $159,629. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI’s annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITIES:**

* Prepare the annual operating and capital budget and quarterly forecasts, integrating utilization, staffing, participant care costs, service-area assumptions, and strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate budget preparation activities with department managers and leadership teams
* Review budget submissions for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Develop and maintain budget and forecast models and planning tools.
* Analyze budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual results by PACE center, service area, program, and operational unit; distinguish drivers and recommend corrective actions or forecast changes.
* Provide detailed financial analyses, trend reports, and recommendations for management.
* Support strategic planning and business cases through scenario modeling and long-range financial projections for growth, expansion, capital investments, reimbursement changes, and other initiatives.
* Prepare and present financial reports, dashboards, and budget summaries for leadership.
* Monitor cost, utilization trends, and departmental spending and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Provide guidance and training on budget policies, procedures, and financial best practices.
* Maintain documentation supporting budget assumptions and financial analyses.
* Support implementation and optimization of financial systems and reporting tools.
* Recommend enhancements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and transparency.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics, public administration, or a closely related field is required.
* Master's degree (MBA, MPA, or related field) preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive budgeting, FP&A, healthcare finance, reimbursement, or financial analytics experience
* 3 years’ experience in healthcare, managed care, PACE, or Medicare Advantage, Medicaid preferred.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting principles, financial analysis, and forecasting methodologies.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis.
* Experience with ERP systems, budgeting software, Power BI, SQL, data warehouses or similar reporting tools. Experience with Adaptive WorkDay Adaptive Planning is preferred.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Background in IT in healthcare organizations of scale
* Experience of M365 / E5 based Contact Center Solutions (e.g. Five 9’s, CISCO UCCE)
* Experience of leading EHR systems (e.g. EPIC)
* Experience of leading ITSMF tools (e.g. Service Now)

The above job description is intended to communicate the general function of the mentioned position and by no means shall be considered an exhaustive or complete outline of the specific tasks and functions that will be required. CEI reserves the right to change job descriptions, site assignments, and or work hours as required by the needs of the program. All employees are expected to perform their duties within their ability as required by the job and/or as requested by management.
